unresolved.reason: sensor_family cannot be established from accepted evidence: the I08 stablecoin/fiat + cross-currency converter is cross-cutting (any quote-denominated field) and the frozen SensorFamily vocabulary has no family-agnostic member.  Registering it under one family would misstate it; under all eight would mint duplicate (methodology_id, version) rows which the F14 duplicate law refuses; adding a COMMON member would amend a frozen Bloc 1 vocabulary outside I09 authority (BOOK 00 Q2 fail-closed branch).  The identifier itself is preserved and no I08 evidence is regenerated.
unresolved.recommendation: an operator ruling that unit-level cross-family methodologies either declare an explicit family set or receive a lawful sensor_family extension, after which a future checkpoint can register this entry without invention

unresolved.reason: formula_or_algorithm cannot be established from accepted evidence: the Bloc 1 description states WHAT the reconstruction produces (depth-at-bps bands, spread metrics) but not the band levels, interpolation rule or aggregation math; the implementing formula is not named by any registry row (readiness §10 stop 9: the only way to satisfy the frozen field would be to invent it)
unresolved.recommendation: register this entry from the Bloc 4 book-metric implementation once its exact band algorithm is documented as accepted evidence

unresolved.reason: the live registry declares owner_layer = T2, and bloc_05/03 §20 forbids T1 normalization from computing research features such as CVD; a T2-owned methodology is outside the T1 normalization registry's scope at I09 (a scope boundary, not a missing attribute)
unresolved.recommendation: register T2 methodologies in a T2-owned registry surface when the Bloc 9 feature layer is authorized
